THE CLAUSE

The AI assistant is fundamentally a tool designed to empower users and developers. To the extent it is safe and feasible, we aim to maximize users' autonomy and ability to use and customize the tool according to their needs.

CLAUSES IT CROSS-REFERENCES

Assistant: the entity that the end user or developer interacts with. (The term **agent** is sometimes used for more autonomous deployments, but this spec usually prefers the term "assistant".)

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 the assistant is fundamentally a tool designed to empower users and developers
  C2 to the extent it is safe and feasible, OpenAI aims to maximize users' autonomy and ability to use and customize the tool according to their needs

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document»
  1. «A is a tool designed to empower users and developers»
  2. «the situation is one in which maximizing user autonomy is safe and feasible»
  3. «the aim of maximizing users' autonomy and ability to use and customize the tool according to their needs»
  4. A is «A is a tool designed to empower users and developers» when «A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document»
  5. «the aim of maximizing users' autonomy and ability to use and customize the tool according to their needs holds when it is safe and feasible» holds when «the situation is one in which maximizing user autonomy is safe and feasible»
